documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Board Meeting Intimation for Consideration And Approval Of The Unaudited Standalone And Consolidated Financial Results Of The Company For The Quarter Ended September 30, 2026.
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: ASK Automotive reported a consolidated revenue growth of 52.1% year-on-year and PAT of Rs. 85 crore for Q1 FY27. Management revised its full-year revenue growth guidance to high teens and increased its FY27 capex plan to approximately Rs. 700 crore. To meet new customer order requirements, the company is setting up a new plant in Bangalore, targeting operationalization before March.

guidance.claim: Management revised its full-year growth guidance for FY27 to high teens.
guidance.quote: We are confident that we will continue to grow not only in mid-teens, but we will be now growing for the full year in high teens.

guidance.claim: The company expects a 20% growth in exports for FY27.
guidance.quote: Last year, we could not go near the target anywhere, but this time, we have given a guidance of 20% increase in the exports, and at the moment, we are still very confident we'll achieve it.

guidance.claim: The company is confident of continuing to grow around mid-teens in FY27.
guidance.quote: We are confident that will continue to grow around mid-teens in FY27.

demand_outlook.claim: Overall vehicle production in India registered a year-on-year growth of 22.1% in Q1 FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: Overall vehicle production across all segments registered a robust year-on-year growth of 22.1% in Q1 FY27.

demand_outlook.claim: Two-wheeler production in India reached 72.5 lakh units in Q1 FY27, growing 22.8% year-on-year.
demand_outlook.quote: The two-wheeler segment, which is most relevant to us, recorded production growth of 22.8% on a year-on-year basis, with total two-wheeler production of 72.5 lakh units in Q1 FY27, up from 59.50 lakh units in the same quarter last year.

demand_outlook.claim: Advanced braking system revenue recorded a 48% year-on-year growth in Q1 FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: Our advanced braking system revenue grew by 48% in Q1 on year-on-year basis.

demand_outlook.claim: Aluminum lightweighting precision solutions segment revenue grew by 75% year-on-year in Q1 FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: The aluminum lightweighting precision solutions revenue grew by 75% in Q1 on year-on-year basis.

demand_outlook.claim: Management remains optimistic on the medium-term industry outlook supported by improving consumer sentiment, expected benefits from the 8th Pay Commission, and continued policy support.
demand_outlook.quote: We also remain optimistic on the medium-term industry outlook supported by improving consumer sentiment, expected benefits from the 8th Pay Commission and continued policy support for manufacturing and formalization through labour reforms.

capex_expansion.claim: Management revised FY27 capex guidance upwards to approximately Rs. 700 crore to support new orders.
capex_expansion.quote: We had given guidance about around Rs. 450 crore to Rs. 500 crore, but the way we are going and receiving the orders, as I today revised the guidance to high-teens, I think our capex may go to something like Rs. 700 crore this year.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is setting up a new plant in Bangalore to cater to new orders, aiming to operationalize it before March.
capex_expansion.quote: We have to set up a new plant in South, that will be in Bangalore at a war footing, and we hope to operationalize it before March in this financial year.

capex_expansion.claim: The company's second captive solar plant of 11.55 MW in Bikaner, Rajasthan is ready for commissioning in Q2 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Our second captive solar plant of 11.55 megawatts at Bikaner, Rajasthan is ready and is expected to be commissioned in Q2FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: The company operationalized a 9.9 MWp Solar Power Plant for captive consumption.
capex_expansion.quote: 9.9 MWp Solar Power Plant for captive consumption operationalized.

capex_expansion.claim: The second captive solar plant of 11.55 megawatt in Bikaner, Rajasthan is expected to be commissioned in Q2 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Our second captive solar plant of 11.55 megawatt in Bikaner, Rajasthan is progressing well and is expected to be commissioned in Q2 FY27, this reflects ASK's special focus on green energy.

capex_expansion.claim: The company will be investing around Rs. 400 Cr in FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: For next year growth of mid-teens, we need to invest around RS.400 Cr which we shall be investing in this year also.

margins_costs.claim: ASK Automotive achieved EBITDA of Rs. 164 crore with an EBITDA margin of 12% in Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: We achieved EBITDA of Rs. 164 crore with 32.7% year-on-year growth. EBITDA margin stood at 12%.

margins_costs.claim: Management expects sustainable overall EBITDA margins to settle between 13.5% and 14%.
margins_costs.quote: The overall margins you will be finding at around 13.5% to 14% in between that.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated EBITDA margins stood at 12.0% for Q1 FY27.
There was a 100% conversion of diesel to PNG in melting furnaces.
margins_costs.quote: 100% conversion of Diesel to PNG in melting furnaces

margins_costs.claim: The EBITDA margin for Q4 FY26 was 12.1%, and would have been higher by 80 basis points without the pass-through alloy prices impact.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin at 12.1%, however, this EBITDA percentage was impacted due to pass-through alloy prices as mentioned earlier. For this impact, EBITDA percentage would have been higher by 80 basis points.

orders_capacity.claim: The company has confirmed alloy wheel orders of Rs. 70 to 90 crore for FY27 and Rs. 250 crore for FY28.
orders_capacity.quote: We have confirmed orders of about Rs. 70 crore to Rs. 90 crore depending on how the customer gear up for this financial year. However, for next financial year, we have confirmed orders of about Rs. 250 crore.

orders_capacity.claim: Ford Motors export orders are expected to generate Rs. 40 to 45 crore in revenue in FY27 and up to Rs. 60 crore in FY28.
orders_capacity.quote: As regards your second question of Ford Motors, we will be doing exports of about Rs. 40 to Rs. 45 crore this year, and next year, it is likely to go up to Rs. 60 crore.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization at the Bengaluru plant has reached 90%.
orders_capacity.quote: Very, very happy to share that Bangalore we have reached 90% capacity utilization that we set up last year, our 18th plant and the third plant in Bengaluru.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization at the Karoli plant is currently at 65%.
orders_capacity.quote: In the Karoli plant, the capacities utilization is still 65%, that is the reason that we have made investment for the alloy wheels.

capital_allocation.claim: The company plans to utilize internal accruals for expansion and raise term loans or working capital finance as needed.
capital_allocation.quote: The philosophy of the company is to completely plow back the internal accruals. We'll be plowing that back, and wherever whether working capital, term loan need arises, we'll take the loan.

capital_allocation.claim: Management expects to maintain its debt-to-equity ratio below 0.5.
capital_allocation.quote: We are still very confident that our debt equity will remain under control and it will be not exceed 0.5.

capital_allocation.claim: The board has recommended a dividend of 92.5%, amounting to Rs. 1.85 per equity share of face value of Rs. 2 each.
capital_allocation.quote: The board has recommended a dividend of 92.5%, that is Rs. 1.85 per equity share of face value of Rs. 2 each.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical conflict in West Asia led to volatility in energy, currency, and raw material markets, raising aluminum alloy prices.
risks_headwinds.quote: As you are aware, after 28th February 2026, the geopolitical conflict in West Asia had created undue volatility in energy, commodity, and currency markets, and had led to a sharp, phenomenal increase in aluminum alloy prices, which affected our industry.

risks_headwinds.claim: Working capital requirements and debt levels increased in Q1 due to rising commodity prices.
risks_headwinds.quote: Yes, it has increased, because due to sudden increase in working capital requirement due to commodity price increase, so there is an increase in debt.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical conflicts in West Asia have disrupted the global economy, posing unprecedented challenges in supply chains and creating volatility in energy, commodity, and currency markets.
risks_headwinds.quote: After 28th February, 2026, geopolitical conflict in West Asia has disrupted the global economy, posing an unprecedented challenge in supply chain, creating undue volatility in energy, commodity and currency across the globe and it has started affecting Indian economy as well.

risks_headwinds.claim: Revenue from exports stood at Rs. 141 Cr in FY26 compared to Rs. 147 Cr in the previous year due to trade disruptions, geopolitical tensions, supply chain issues, logistic costs, and higher tariff rates.
risks_headwinds.quote: Our revenue from exports were at Rs. 141 Cr in FY26 against Rs. 147 Cr last year because of the trade disruptions due to higher tariff rates, geopolitical tensions, supply chain issues, logistic costs and other bottlenecks.

management_commitments.claim: Management aims to operationalize the new Bangalore plant before March in this financial year.
management_commitments.quote: We have to set up a new plant in South, that will be in Bangalore at a war footing, and we hope to operationalize it before March in this financial year.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to commission its second captive solar plant of 11.55 MW in Bikaner during Q2 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Our second captive solar plant of 11.55 megawatts at Bikaner, Rajasthan is ready and is expected to be commissioned in Q2FY27.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets full-year revenue growth in high teens for FY27.
management_commitments.quote: We are confident that we will continue to grow not only in mid-teens, but we will be now growing for the full year in high teens.

management_commitments.claim: The second captive solar plant in Bikaner, Rajasthan is expected to be commissioned in Q2 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Our second captive solar plant of 11.55 megawatt in Bikaner, Rajasthan is progressing well and is expected to be commissioned in Q2 FY27, this reflects ASK's special focus on green energy.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to invest around Rs. 400 Cr in FY27.
management_commitments.quote: For next year growth of mid-teens, we need to invest around RS.400 Cr which we shall be investing in this year also.

management_commitments.claim: The company is confident of growing around mid-teens in FY27.
management_commitments.quote: We are confident that will continue to grow around mid-teens in FY27.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
